description: Only feature records with a count strictly greater than 489 are kept.

c.request: Looking only at feature records whose `traitcount` passes the 489 threshold, and matching them to sites via `scanfeatures.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry` (unmatched ones left out), break them down by site code (`scanfeatures.zoneref`) and access status (`sites.entrystat`). For each combination, give the site code, the access status, the average `traitcount` (ignoring missing values), the record count, and that count's share of the overall total record count (no rows if there is no total). Sort by share, highest first with missing last, show the top 10, and don't round. Only feature records with a count strictly greater than 489 are kept.
c.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(f.traitcount) AS average_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures AS f INNER JOIN sites AS s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat), shares AS (SELECT grouped.*, 1.0 * record_count / NULLIF(SUM(record_count) OVER (), 0) AS record_share FROM grouped) SELECT site_code, access_status, average_traitcount, record_count, record_share FROM shares ORDER BY record_share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

a.request: Join feature records (`scanfeatures`) to their sites on `scanfeatures.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry`, dropping unmatched records. Keep only records with a `traitcount` greater than 489. Then group by site code (`scanfeatures.zoneref`) and site access status (`sites.entrystat`). For each group, show the site code, the access status, the average `traitcount` (ignoring missing values), the number of records, and that record count as a fraction of the total record count across all groups (no rows if there is no total). Sort by the fraction, highest first with missing last, keep the top 10, and don't round.
a.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(f.traitcount) AS average_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures AS f INNER JOIN sites AS s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT site_code, access_status, average_traitcount, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS record_fraction FROM grouped ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

b.request: For feature records with `scanfeatures.traitcount > 489` that join to `sites` on `scanfeatures.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry`, group by site code and access status; return each group’s site code, access status, average non-null `traitcount`, record count, and record count divided by the total count of all qualifying joined records. Return no rows if the total is zero, sort by share descending with null shares last, limit to 10 rows, and do not round.
b.sql: SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(f.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f JOIN sites AS s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
b.raw: For feature records with `scanfeatures.traitcount > 489` that join to `sites` on `scanfeatures.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry`, group by site code and access status; return each group’s site code, access status, average non-null `traitcount`, record count, and record count divided by the total count of all qualifying joined records. Return no rows if the total is zero, sort by share descending with null shares last, limit to 10 rows, and do not round.

d.request: For `scanfeatures` records with `traitcount > 489`, inner join `sites` on `scanfeatures.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry`; group by `scanfeatures.zoneref` and `sites.entrystat`, and return the site code, access status, unrounded average non-null `traitcount`, record count, and that count divided by the total count of qualifying joined records. Return no rows if the total count is zero; sort by share descending with nulls last and limit to 10 rows.
d.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sf.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS average_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures AS sf INNER JOIN sites AS s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT site_code, access_status, average_traitcount, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM grouped ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
